assumptions: Primeira ordem, pórtico Euler-Bernoulli e mola axial bilateral EA/L.
Rotação inativa em nós apenas axiais é eliminada matematicamente, não representa apoio.
Sem peso próprio, vento, flambagem, resistência normativa ou liberação para fabricação.

geometry_analysis.source: Explicit synthetic sharp-inner-corner Ue; not a commercial product

section.source: Synthetic analytical beam/tie; not a commercial profile or building

study.source: Explicit S-S fork supports, free warping, end restraints only, uniform axial compression
study.boundary_and_load_pattern: Synthetic elastic member, 2 m physical span, no intermediate connections; no inferred supports

conditional_dependencies: cFSM eigenvalues were computed in explicit modal spaces and a finite half-wave domain; completeness beyond that domain and complete physical-mode applicability are not certified.

remaining: Connections/net-section provenance and load introduction/web crippling are not fully verified.
Complete normative action/combination and global stability validation remain separate.
C.5 effective inertia is not substituted silently into the gross-section displacement field.

connection_audit.warning: Known contradictions checked; this inventory does not prove absence of cutouts, weld coverage of every section element or governing net paths/Ct. Tension stays conditional.

global_result.axes: NBR x,y = JPN section local y,z

geometry_audit.note: Gross section computed, effective properties and elastic critical mode classification are separate.
